long_biography.plain_text:
Breiteneder Immobilien Parking combines a family-owned real-estate platform with an operating infrastructure business. Johann Breiteneder has worked across its parking, property, finance and hospitality companies, giving him responsibility across several parts of the family platform. The operating model spans planning, financing, construction, operation and maintenance.

As chief executive, Breiteneder oversees Best in Parking alongside development and hotel interests. Family members and family foundations own the parent group, linking succession with long-term operational responsibility. His remit also includes capital-markets financing and a strategy that treats parking garages as mobility infrastructure, combining physical assets with payment technology and electric-vehicle charging.

uncertainties.detail: Identity confidence is 89. The source owner record already states that Croatian shipping and corporate registers connected the Austrian owner to Johann Breiteneder's parking business, while current official sources and a 1975 birth date resolve the living executive and distinguish him from his father and an unrelated older politician. The underlying open-web vessel ownership document was not independently retrieved, so private-vessel context remains selection and disambiguation evidence only and is excluded from biographies, classifications and tags.

Johann Breiteneder senior founded the group around the Vienna State Opera garage. The subject is the son born in 1975, described as Johann junior in independent reporting, active in the group since 1995 and now chief executive. Claims about the original founding decision belong to the father; claims about later operating leadership and international expansion belong to the son.

The founder-son relationship, prior-generation business and Johann's present beneficial ownership positively support a family transfer. No reviewed source identifies inheritance, a gift, a family purchase or another legal transfer instrument, so Marriage / family transfer is used rather than Inherited or Inherited and expanded. The long operating record is captured separately by the Operator relationship.

Real Estate covers the dominant parking-property and broader development platform. Parking also has an infrastructure and service component, but the business develops, owns, finances and operates physical property under ownership, concession and lease structures, and both current company and issuer sources place it within real estate. Hospitality and group finance are material supporting activities but not better principal-industry choices.

The exact LinkedIn profile and official company website meet the proposal threshold. Birth day, month and year are supported by repeated current government beneficial-owner records. Birthplace, birth country and secondary nationality remain unresolved; Austrian citizenship is not used to infer an Austrian birthplace. Searches for Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok and a personal website found no collision-safe personal account.

Commercial real estate captures the principal asset and industry dimension, while Property developer adds a distinct practiced-role dimension under current executive leadership. Hotel operations, hospitality real estate, infrastructure investment and narrower asset-class tags were omitted to keep the set minimal. The active catalogue has no parking-operations tag, so parking and mobility infrastructure remain in the narrative and tag evidence; no taxonomy candidate was created.
